text: Bスプラインsmooth PMEの格子・次数収束 電荷をBスプラインで格子へ割り当て、FFTでEwald逆空間項を評価するsmooth PME（SPME）の小規模例です。 台帳・件数の説明 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 結果・検証記録手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 Ewaldと同じ中性立方セルと実空間項を使います。PME族のうちEssmannらのBスプライン変種を採用し、Dardenらの原法のLagrange補間とは区別します。 採用した計算法 4次または6次のcardinal Bスプラインのテンソル積で電荷を格子化し、節点スプラインの離散構造因子補正、Gaussian Green関数、3次元FFTを組み合わせます。格子エネルギーを重みの位置微分で解析的に微分します。 Qj=∑iqi∏a=13Mp(uia−ja+p/2)Qj​=i∑​qi​a=1∏3​Mp​(uia​−ja​+p/2) Fi=−∂Eh/∂riFi​=−∂Eh​/∂ri​ 何と比較し、何を測るか Registry and counting notes These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Results and verificationMethods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries The neutral cubic cell and real-space term match the Ewald example. The adopted PME-family variant uses Essmann-type B-splines, distinct from Darden’s original Lagrange interpolation. Adopted numerical method Tensor-product cardinal splines of order four or six spread the charges. Apply the nodal-spline discrete structure-factor correction and Gaussian Green function through 3D FFTs; analytically differentiate assignment weights for forces. Shared real/self terms are stated. Check finest-grid force derivatives by energy differences and verify assigned total charge. Verification limits and failures Finite-mesh aliasing permits nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant; that diagnostic is reported. No exact momentum conservation, long MD, original PME, optimized P³M or slab validation is claimed. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
